name: Flashcards
description: Write flashcards in shared decks and study them with per-user spaced-repetition progress
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read flashcards and decks; require auth for creating flashcards, studying and recording answers, and only a card's author may update or delete it (403 otherwise); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Flashcard validation: question is a required non-empty string of at most 500 characters, answer a required non-empty string of at most 2000 characters, deck an optional string of at most 100 characters (empty means the card has no deck)

GET /api/flashcards lists active cards, newest first; ?query= matches question or answer case-insensitively, ?deck= keeps cards of that exact deck, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every matching card
GET /api/decks lists every deck name used by an active card with its card_count, sorted by name; cards without a deck are not listed
DELETE /api/flashcards/:id removes the card and everyone's progress on it permanently

Study progress is kept per user and card in five boxes: a card nobody has answered starts in box 1 for that user; POST /api/flashcards/:id/answers with correct true moves it up one box (at most 5) and with correct false back to box 1, increments correct_count or incorrect_count and sets last_studied_at

GET /api/study returns the signed-in user's study queue: active cards (of ?deck= when given) ordered by box ascending, then never-studied cards before the least recently studied; ?limit= caps the queue (default 20, at most 100) while total counts every card that matches
Deactivated cards (is_active false) are left out of the lists, the decks and the study queue and answer 404 on the public card endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for another author's card or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone can browse cards and decks and flip cards read-only; signed-in users also get the create controls, edit and delete on their own cards, and study mode, and visitors see a 'Sign in to create and study flashcards' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out

Card browser: a deck picker filled from the deck list, a search box over question and answer text, and previous/next paging; each card shows its question and flips with an animation to reveal the answer

Study mode: shows one card from the study queue at a time, flips it on request and offers 'Got it' and 'Missed it' buttons that record the answer and move to the next card, with the card's box shown and a summary at the end of the queue
Create and edit card forms (question, answer, deck) that show the API's validation messages next to the form; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every card, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and the number of decks
Toggle a card's active status from the overview
